context_for_next_testing_agent: Performance overhaul verified. Key implementations: 1) lib/auth.js reads localStorage immediately and sets loading=false before /auth/me API call, 2) App.js uses React.lazy for all pages (DashboardPage, DealsPage, NewDealPage, TreasuryPage, ReferenceDataPage, UsersPage, TransactionHistoryPage, AuditLogPage), 3) DashboardPage uses hasData ref to show skeleton only on first load, opacity transition on subsequent loads, 4) All data tables use 'loading && data.length === 0' for initial spinner, wrap content in div with 'opacity-60' during subsequent loads, 5) Backend /api/dashboard/stats uses MongoDB $facet aggregation for efficient stats calculation. Dialog overlay uses bg-black/40 with duration-150. All modals open/close smoothly.
